title: eludite.resx.set input
description: Write cells of resource sets, as editing in the grid does (proposal 0005): a value or comment in one culture of one key, in any number of cells. A cell in a culture file that has no entry for the key is created on the fly, in Visual Studio's shape, at the end of the file; every untouched byte of the file stays (the edit is a splice). Class edit_buffer: a person's write lands in the files (an open `.resx` text document changes in its buffer), an agent's is a pending change until accepted, or applied at once under the policy's `edit_buffer: accept`. A neutral file that has a designer file gets it regenerated by the host after the write when a key was added.

set.description: The resource set: the path of its neutral `.resx` file (absolute, or relative to the workspace folder), or of any of its culture files, which names the same set.

key.description: The key; created in the neutral file when it does not exist there and `value` is given for the neutral culture.

culture.description: A culture name (`de`, `de-DE`, `sr-Latn-RS`), or the empty string for the neutral file.

value.description: The new value; null removes the entry from this culture's file (never from the neutral file: use eludite.resx.remove). Omitted: the value is kept.

comment.description: The new comment; null or empty removes it. Omitted: kept. On the neutral entry the `{Invariant}` marker is kept whatever the comment, `invariant` governs it.

invariant.description: Mark (true) or unmark (false) the key as invariant: the `{Invariant}` marker in the neutral entry's comment. Omitted: kept.

create_culture.description: Create a culture file that does not exist yet (`Name.<culture>.resx`, with the neutral file's header) instead of refusing the cell. Default: false.
